gary_2026_11_17_exec_dinner_why_isn_t_ai.summary: Gary's Guide: A private dinner for PE investors & the SaaS leaders they back. Most PE-backed SaaS companies have already given their product & engineering teams AI tools, & boards expected faster results from the same spend. For most, the roadmap hasn't moved. Operators see the same release cadence as two years ago. Investors see AI spend that hasn't paid off. Same problem, two seats. gary_2026_11_18_mise_en_table_mutual_sup.summary: Gary's Guide: Building a food brand or business is hard. The stakes are real, the learning curve is steep, & there's no clear roadmap - just a long series of tasks & decisions you mostly have to figure out on your own. What if you didn't have to do it alone? Mise en Table is a monthly gathering for the people doing the work to bring great food & dining experiences to life. This is about creating the conditions for people working in food & beverage to set themselves up for success - by sharing resources, asking hard questions, putting everything on the table, & building the kind of mutual support that only comes from a real community of peers. This isn't another networking event. It's a free, working peer group where food entrepreneurs, creatives, & operators come together to share resources, solve real problems, & build the kind of connections that actually move your work forward. No panels. No pitching. Just a room full of people who get it. Who is this for? Food & beverage brand founders, chefs, bakers, restaurant/bar/cafe owners, food writers, photographers, stylists, supper club hosts, hospitality executives, food tech operators - & anyone else building something in the food & beverage space. Seats are limited to create a safe space for sharing & building real connections. Come as you are - ready to put it all out on the table to set yourself & fellow builders up for success. What to Expect Every session has a simple rotating format - a resource swap, a show-and-tell, a live problem-solving session, Q&A with a guest who supports the industry - plus ample time to connect & find your next collaborator. The format for this session will be Giving & Thanks! Since this is our last gathering before Thanksgiving, let's make it festive with a casual potluck lunch. We'll have postcards on hand to write a letter of gratitude to someone who has made a difference in your life this year. Come prepared with one resource to share: a vendor you trust, a tool that's saved you time, a contact you'd vouch for, a template that's been useful. You'll leave with a list of what everyone recommended - & an invite to our resource library where we'll keep a running list of people, tools, & tips recommended by the community. Agenda Mise En Table: Giving & Thanks: Potluck Lunch, Gratitude Letters, Resource Share 12:00 - 12:15: Arrivals + Lunch Table Setup Coffee & tea provided. Bring a bite to share for our potluck lunch. 12:15 - 12:30: Fill Your Plate + Quick Intros Share your name, what you're working on right now, & the dish you brought. 12:30 - 1:30: Resource Share Share your favorite resources & recommendations over lunch. Come prepared with at least one resource to share: a vendor you trust, a tool that's saved you time, a contact you'd vouch for, a template that's been useful 1:30 - 1:50: Gratitude Postcards & Connections We'll have postcards available for writing letters of gratitude. Unstructured time to follow up on resources & intros. 1:50 - 2:00: Closing + Vote for Next Month's Format + Signup for Holiday Market One ask, one offer from anyone who wants to share. Their own working toolkit. Research, idea testing, building & review tools, set up & ready to use. The Leverage kit. Every prompt & tool used in the series. Good habits. Check the sources. Set the target first. Never let the builder grade its own work. A cohort. A group of founders who built alongside them. Session 2: Build Move from validation to a working product. Founders write a focused one-page plan based on customer interviews, building exclusively to test their biggest assumption. An AI verification tool tests the build against the plan before launch, followed by rapid 60-second live demos & peer critiques.
